title: Invariance Under Equivalent Predicates
statement:
Let $P$ and $P'$ be predicates on Boolean assignments that agree on every assignment. For any finite quantifier prefix, Boolean assignment $	ext{ let }
\sigma$, and natural-number starting index $i$, the prefix is true with predicate $P$ exactly when it is true with predicate $P'$.
